info.prompt: A cyber-gothic arena where towering ribbed arches pulse with neon cyan and electric magenta veins, their skeletal gold filigree casting long shadows across void-black marble floors streaked with synaptic circuitry. The player's interface manifests as floating translucent dice—faceted ice-stone gems glowing amber from within—orbiting a central terminal where hacker text scrolls too fast to read. Camera sweeps through oscillating lightbeams as the background shifts from cobalt to crimson to molten gold, each transition marked by chapter banners materializing from fractured glass.
